reader_summary.overview: Acquired returns with a very special Part II of the Sequoia Capital story. Since 1996, Doug has served as Sequoia’s Global Managing Partner, in charge of overseeing the firm’s incredible expansion from a single. Doug is incredibly candid and insightful about all that has gone into building the modern Sequoia: from winning Google and missing Facebook.
